research_cases.public_summary: Every odd generalized pivotal rotation must factor through a cyclic spin character. All 1,144 tested blocks pass. The all-order path-Clifford divisibility condition for R′(m) holds exactly when m is even, including m=4. No compatible associators or categorification are constructed.

Saturated modular representations determine all indicator sequences and every central phase mass. The eight spin objects form four dual pairs, all restricting to 2X+2gX+sigma+3T. Exact phase Gram constraints leave 640 labelled restriction-data profiles in three branches of 68,286,286. These data neither construct nor exclude a categorification.
